capabilities: open local HTML links from Reading View with one click
run a command to open the HTML link under the cursor in Source Mode or Live Preview
resolve vault-relative link paths including URL-encoded spaces and non-ASCII filenames
configure a custom browser executable or use the system default
verify targets stay inside the vault and reject symlink escapes before opening
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It is desktop-only (requires a local filesystem vault, no mobile support), warns that opened HTML pages can execute JavaScript without sandboxing, and notes that pages needing a web server may fail under file://. Also documents limitations like fragments not forwarded via the system default app.
problem: Obsidian keeps interactive HTML demos, reports and standalone web pages next to notes but gives no safe way to launch those local .html/.htm files in an external browser from a link.

relations.evidence: specify Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or another browser executable

requires.name: browser or system default HTML application

summary: Opens local HTML file links in Markdown notes with the system default app or a user-chosen browser executable.
